title: WaterColor 30 WaterColor Boulevard Unit 201
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: *Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count.**This home is allowed 4 amenity access bands.**- Walking distance to the beach- Centrally located in WaterColor and walking distance to Town Center- Washer/Dryer- Parking can be found throughout the community.- 2 bikes provided- Newly remodeled master bathroom- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, a third pool with zero-entry, an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Situated in the heart of world-famous WaterColor, Florida, and located directly above Wine World, this 1-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo offers an idyllic getaway for couples or a small family. This unit comfortably accommodates 4 guests and is within walking distance to WaterColor's shops, dining venues, and the Emerald Coast pristine beaches. Recent updates to the kitchen, reflect brand new cabinetry and stainless-steel appliances. The kitchen is fully equipped to prepare a gourmet meal. There is also a dining table that seats 4, with 2 additional seats at the breakfast bar. The primary bedroom has a king bed with a flat-screen TV and newly remodeled bathroom in 2024! There is also a bunk room off the living area with a twin-over-full bunk bed and direct access to the screened-in porch with new outdoor seating. This bunk shares a bathroom with shower with additional guests to utilize and a back porch with sunny views of the neighborhood. Cerulean Park rests directly across from this unit and offers a great place to relax with your favorite book. The 2 adult bikes provide a great alternative way to explore WaterColor's winding roads and the surrounding 30A area. When you're ready to venture out of WaterColor, be sure to check out the fabulous shopping and dining venues in neighboring Seaside and Seagrove. Check availability and book with 360 Blue today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENT: (Sleeps 4)- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower- Bunk Room: Twin-over-Full Bunk Bed *Please note that the bunk bed best accommodates only 2 people.*WATERCOLOR NEIGHBORHOOD HIGHLIGHTS: - Named the #1 family vacation destination in the U.S.- A 499-acre coastal resort and residential community- Ideal bike community perfect for family getaways- Pristine sugar sand beaches- 6 swimming pools- Pickle ball courts- Award-winning tennis facilities- Championship golf nearby- World Famous Beach Club- Unparalleled beachside, poolside, and lakeside dining- Acres of parks, gardens, and footpaths- Nearby state parks and preserves*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.Please note: Effective January 11th 2024, Watercolor Community HOA will no longer allow Low-Speed Vehicles to be rented by guests staying in the Town Center Condos.*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.
